cover.headline: How Australia's national teams get paid.

rows.sub: At least, of national team revenue
PFA acts for players, per AAP
Says it relates to a separate matter

caption:
How Australia's national teams get paid.

Socceroos and Matildas players, through the PFA, have taken action against Football Australia in the NSW Supreme Court, per AAP. A seven-figure claim is understood. FA says it relates to a separate matter.

Behind it sits a revenue-share model that began in 2019 and was rebuilt in 2023, with payments split 70 per cent match fees and 30 per cent commercial.

The current deal expires in 2027, and talks on the next one haven't started.
